---
title: "Database Downloads"
subtitle: Download links for the five slim SQLite databases
---

Each source's slim database is published as an asset on the GitHub release of its
pilot repository. All five share the common [DB Schema (Slim)](./db-schema-slim.qmd)
— the same seven tables, differing only in a few source-specific columns.

## Available databases

| Source | File | Download |
|:-------|:-----|:---------|
| Mareano | `mareano_slim.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/mareano-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.16/mareano_slim.sqlite) |
| Vannmiljø | `vannmiljo_slim.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/vannmiljo-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.16/vannmiljo_slim.sqlite) |
| ICES-DOME | `ices_dome_slim.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/ices-dome-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.17/ices_dome_slim.sqlite) |
| MUDAB | `mudab_slim.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/mudab-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.4/mudab_slim.sqlite) |
| 4Demon | `4demon_slim.sqlite` | [Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/4demon-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.0/4demon_slim.sqlite) |

: Slim databases {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[25,45,30]"}

::: {.callout-note}
Each file is a self-contained SQLite database. See the
[DB Schema (Slim)](./db-schema-slim.qmd) page for the table definitions and the
per-source column comparison.
:::
